title: Songworld prototype and real GPU pipeline experiment
whatWorks: The founder played the local Three.js platformer and tested camera/turning changes. Controls now have persistent tuning sliders. A first structural biome pass adds connected ground, city blocks, caverns, terraces and coastal islands. A real Hunyuan3D 2.1 textured arch was generated, imported locally and rendered. ACE-Step generated a real 75-second instrumental benchmark and saved it locally. HY World 2.0 WorldMirror reconstructed depth, normals, camera parameters and a point cloud from one image.
blocker: Work stopped at the user's request for VM deprovisioning. Full integrated generation is incomplete: no preserved verified Nemotron story artifact, only one real Hunyuan landmark, incomplete biome banks and no full HY World generation. Reconstruction is not a playable generated world. The newest Nemotron cache configuration was still starting when stopped.
nextTask: Inspect the local prototype and archived GPU logs, then complete one playable world using a preserved real Nemotron story, its generated ACE-Step soundtrack and a complete validated Hunyuan biome bank before expanding the remaining biomes.
notes: Verified results, unfinished work, shutdown evidence, backup contents and lessons are recorded in details. No story was marked complete.

details.shutdown: songworld-models container inspected as exited, Running=false; hardware monitor stopped; no vLLM/ACE/generation workers found; nvidia-smi showed 0 MiB and 0% utilization. The VM itself was not deleted by the agent; user was explicitly signaled it was ready to deprovision.
details.backup: artifacts/vm-session-backup-2026-10-12.tar.gz contains VM assets, logs, worker scripts and the Nemotron parser. SHA256 c4afce6dc2a03b9fc4a0e0794d7bc3a3494e35ab049374f7c794266ef5f9b600 matched remotely and locally. Model checkpoints and Python environments are not included; reinstall/redownload rather than assuming they were preserved.

lessons: The actual VM was H200, approximately 141 GB VRAM, despite the planned B200. Detect architecture before selecting quantization or dependencies.
Nemotron 120B FP8 used 114.12 GiB for weights; initial total GPU usage was 136135 MiB. Large preallocated KV cache was wasteful for one short story.

vLLM sleep took 684 seconds and substantially consumed host RAM. Avoid per-track offloading of a 114 GiB model. Smaller cache allocation 0.86 was being evaluated with ACE resident but did not complete verification before shutdown.

A real Nemotron request returned HTTP 200, but its verification artifact was lost because finally cleanup timed out. Save successful outputs before GPU lifecycle operations; this is now implemented and fixture-tested.

ACE-Step lazy-loads on the first task; models_initialized=false on /health does not mean startup is broken. A real warm 75-second generation/download took about nine seconds on H200. Logged PyTorch peak allocation was about 6.28 GB; two-second host samples can miss brief peaks.
Hunyuan3D 2.1 produces standard textured meshes usable in Three.js. HY World 2.0 reconstruction outputs are separate; do not present point clouds or splats as game-ready GLBs.
One beautiful generated landmark does not validate tile seams, collision, visibility or a complete playable level. Keep those requirements explicit.
Palette and prop swaps do not create distinct courses. Structural terrain and gameplay routes must vary, and the current first pass still shares many obstacles/objectives.
Keep camera response and avatar turning independently adjustable. User feedback favored responsive controls and persistent settings over one imposed smoothing profile.

Use an official CUDA development container and isolated Python environments. Install libglm-dev for gsplat, use cupy-cuda12x wheels, preserve LF shell endings, and invoke uploaded scripts with bash when executable permissions are absent.
Blender 4.2 could segfault during interpreter teardown after a valid export. The worker validates outputs and flushes CUDA before explicit exit; inference errors must still fail normally.
Track elapsed startup/compile time, memory and cost from the beginning. Do not treat SSH observation timeouts as terminal process failures or restart live work solely because polling expired.
The original one-hour target was met only for a local prototype, not the full model-backed product. Future planning must make that distinction explicit.
details.verification: 27 tests passed after terrain changes; the four model adapter tests, including preserving a story before failed cleanup, passed after the latest adapter change. No full end-to-end generated-world completion was claimed.
details.futureAuthorization: Do not recreate/start a paid VM or resume cloud spending automatically. The user ended this session and cleared the active goal.
